label: Total Reported Cases (Confirmed + Probable)
contestNote: Combines 18,445 lab-confirmed cases with 13,505 additional non-lab-confirmed/pending cases per CDC's Sept 1 update; distinct from the narrower multistate outbreak count of 11,458. A further 3,491 cases await classification of domestic vs. international acquisition and are not included in this total. Food-safety attorney Bill Marler's independent fifty-state tally has since climbed to roughly 33,525 as of Sept 4 (from 32,857 on Sept 1), even as CDC announced Sept 4 it is reducing update frequency and only 13 of the 41 states that ever published case data still maintain a public page — meaning CDC's own combined total likely understates the true count going forward.
